claim_ceiling: Finite-set descriptive numerical projection; no new semantic, population, or causal evidence

estimators.balanced_accuracy: Unweighted mean of correctness over supported and unsupported proposition classes
estimators.missingness: Incomplete runs are refused, not filtered into apparently complete tables
estimators.primary: Full continuation log-probability difference; all candidate tokens summed
estimators.root_success: All six report-state by assertion cells correct for one question/answer format
estimators.secondary: First divergent continuation-token log-probability difference; never substituted for primary
estimators.ties: Zero margin; retained in full denominator and never counted correct

label_mapping.interpretation: Decoded answer agreement is distinct from joint correctness
